title: AWS Production Masterclass
subtitle: From Zero to Production-Ready AWS Architect
description: Build, deploy, secure, scale, and operate a real AWS production environment — one chapter at a time. 47 chapters. One continuous project.

modules.title: AWS IAM — Secure Access & Permissions
modules.description: Security foundation: Users, Groups, Roles, Policies, MFA, least-privilege, and cross-account access.
modules.productionStory: Who can access what? Least privilege is the #1 security practice on AWS.

modules.title: Amazon S3 — Store Files & Static Assets
modules.description: Object storage: buckets, storage classes, versioning, lifecycle policies, pre-signed URLs, and event notifications.
modules.productionStory: Where do we store images, CSS, user uploads? S3 is the answer.

modules.title: Amazon EC2 — Launch Your First Server
modules.description: Virtual servers: instance types, AMIs, Security Groups, EBS, Auto Scaling, and purchasing options.
modules.productionStory: The network is ready. Now deploy a web application on a virtual server.

modules.title: Amazon VPC — Build Your Network Foundation
modules.description: Cloud networking: subnets, route tables, NAT, NACLs vs Security Groups, VPC Endpoints, and peering.
modules.productionStory: Before launching anything, we need a network. VPC is your private data center in the cloud.

modules.title: Amazon CloudWatch — Monitor Everything
modules.description: Metrics, alarms, Logs, Logs Insights, dashboards, custom metrics, and EMF.
modules.productionStory: The app is live. How do we know it is healthy? CloudWatch answers this.

modules.title: Amazon RDS — Relational Databases
modules.description: Managed databases: Multi-AZ, Read Replicas, Aurora, RDS Proxy, backups, and Lambda integration.
modules.productionStory: Every real application needs a database. RDS gives you managed MySQL, PostgreSQL, Aurora.

modules.title: Amazon Route 53 — DNS & Domain Names
modules.description: DNS service: hosted zones, record types, routing policies, health checks, and failover.
modules.productionStory: Users need a domain name, not an IP address. Route 53 maps names to resources.

modules.title: AWS Lambda — Serverless Compute
modules.description: Lambda fundamentals, execution lifecycle, handler, event/context objects, cold starts, runtimes, and your first function.
modules.productionStory: Run code without managing servers. Pay only for what you use.

modules.title: Amazon API Gateway — Build REST APIs
modules.description: REST APIs, HTTP APIs, Lambda proxy integration, authorization, throttling, and CORS.
modules.productionStory: Expose Lambda functions as REST APIs. Handle auth, throttling, CORS.

modules.title: Amazon DynamoDB — NoSQL Database
modules.description: NoSQL data modeling, CRUD operations, Streams, GSI/LSI, and Lambda integration.
modules.productionStory: Serverless database for serverless apps. Single-digit millisecond latency at any scale.

modules.title: Amazon Cognito — User Authentication
modules.description: User authentication, OAuth 2.0, user pools, identity pools, and Lambda triggers.
modules.productionStory: Users need to sign up and log in. Cognito handles auth so you do not have to.

modules.title: Amazon SQS — Message Queues
modules.description: Message queuing, producer/consumer, visibility timeout, DLQ, and Lambda event source mapping.
modules.productionStory: Decouple services. Handle async work. Never lose a message.

modules.title: Amazon SNS — Notifications & Fan-Out
modules.description: Pub/sub messaging, fan-out patterns, message filtering, and Lambda subscriptions.
modules.productionStory: Send notifications. Fan out one event to multiple consumers.

modules.title: Amazon EventBridge — Event-Driven Architecture
modules.description: Event-driven architecture, event buses, rules, patterns, scheduler, and Lambda targets.
modules.productionStory: React to events across AWS services. Build loosely-coupled event-driven systems.

modules.title: Amazon ECR — Container Registry
modules.description: Container registry: immutable tags, vulnerability scanning, lifecycle policies, and cross-account access.
modules.productionStory: Store Docker images securely. Scan for vulnerabilities automatically.

modules.title: Amazon ECS — Container Orchestration
modules.description: Container orchestration: clusters, task definitions, services, ALB integration, and launch types.
modules.productionStory: Run containerized applications at scale. Auto-heal. Auto-scale.

modules.title: AWS Fargate — Serverless Containers
modules.description: Serverless containers: awsvpc networking, capacity providers, task sizing, and Spot pricing.
modules.productionStory: Containers without managing servers. Focus on the app, not the infrastructure.

modules.title: Elastic Load Balancing — Distribute Traffic
modules.description: Application traffic routing: ALB vs NLB, target groups, listeners, rules, and health checks.
modules.productionStory: One server is not enough. Distribute traffic across multiple EC2 instances.

modules.title: AWS CodeBuild — CI Build Automation
modules.description: Continuous integration: buildspec.yml, environments, artifacts, caching, and ECR integration.
modules.productionStory: Automate builds. Test on every commit. Build Docker images.

modules.title: AWS CodePipeline — CD Pipeline
modules.description: Continuous delivery: stages, actions, artifacts, transitions, manual approvals, and ECS deployments.
modules.productionStory: Automate deployments end-to-end. From git push to production.

modules.title: AWS CloudFormation — Infrastructure as Code
modules.description: Infrastructure as Code: templates, stacks, parameters, change sets, drift detection, and SAM.
modules.productionStory: Define your entire infrastructure in code. Reproducible. Version-controlled.

modules.title: AWS KMS — Encryption & Key Management
modules.description: Key Management Service, encryption at rest, customer managed keys, envelope encryption.
modules.productionStory: Encrypt everything — data at rest and in transit. KMS manages your keys.

modules.title: AWS STS — Temporary Credentials & Roles
modules.description: Security Token Service, assuming roles, temporary credentials, cross-account access.
modules.productionStory: Cross-account access without sharing passwords. Temporary tokens, not permanent keys.

modules.title: AWS Secrets Manager — Manage Credentials
modules.description: Securely store and rotate database credentials, API keys, and secrets.
modules.productionStory: Never hardcode passwords. Secrets Manager stores and rotates them automatically.

modules.title: AWS Systems Manager — Operations Hub
modules.description: Parameter Store, Session Manager, Run Command — manage servers without SSH.
modules.productionStory: Manage EC2 instances at scale. No SSH keys. Centralized configuration.

modules.title: AWS CloudTrail — Audit API Activity
modules.description: Track user activity and API usage across your AWS infrastructure.
modules.productionStory: Who changed what and when? CloudTrail provides the audit trail.

modules.title: AWS Config — Resource Compliance
modules.description: Assess, audit, and evaluate resource configurations for compliance.
modules.productionStory: Is every resource configured correctly? Config checks continuously.

modules.title: AWS Backup — Data Protection & DR
modules.description: Centralized backup management, vaults, recovery points, Vault Lock, cross-region copy.
modules.productionStory: Backup everything. Recover from disaster. Meet compliance requirements.

modules.title: Amazon CloudFront — CDN & Edge Delivery
modules.description: Global Content Delivery Network, caching, edge locations, OAC, and Lambda@Edge.
modules.productionStory: Serve content globally from 400+ edge locations with sub-second latency.

modules.title: AWS WAF & Shield — Web App Security
modules.description: Web Application Firewall, DDoS protection, managed rules, rate limiting.
modules.productionStory: Protect your web application from SQL injection, XSS, and DDoS attacks.

modules.title: AWS Organizations — Multi-Account Governance
modules.description: Centrally manage and govern multiple AWS accounts with SCPs and Control Tower.
modules.productionStory: Scale from one account to many. Enterprise governance and billing.

modules.title: AWS PrivateLink — Private Connectivity
modules.description: Securely access services over the AWS network without the internet.
modules.productionStory: Access AWS services without exposing traffic to the internet.

modules.title: Amazon ElastiCache — In-Memory Caching
modules.description: In-memory caching with Redis and Memcached. Sub-millisecond latency.
modules.productionStory: Speed up the app. Cache hot data. Reduce database load by 90%.

modules.title: Amazon OpenSearch — Search & Log Analytics
modules.description: Search, analyze, and visualize data in real-time with dashboards.
modules.productionStory: Search logs at scale. Analyze patterns. Visualize with dashboards.

modules.title: AWS Step Functions — Workflow Orchestration
modules.description: Visual workflow service: state machines, ASL, error handling, retries, parallel execution.
modules.productionStory: Coordinate multi-step serverless workflows. Visual editor. Built-in retries.

modules.title: AWS IAM Identity Center — SSO & Workforce
modules.description: Centralized workforce access management, SSO, permission sets.
modules.productionStory: One login for all AWS accounts. Single sign-on for your entire team.

modules.title: Amazon Bedrock & GenAI — AI-Powered Apps
modules.description: Build and scale Generative AI applications with foundation models, RAG, and agents.
modules.productionStory: Add generative AI to your production app. Claude, Titan, Llama — one API.

modules.title: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) — SSL/TLS Certificates
modules.description: Free SSL/TLS certificates, DNS & email validation, auto-renewal, ALB & CloudFront integration.
modules.productionStory: Free managed SSL certificates that auto-renew. Never worry about expired certs again.

modules.title: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling — Automatic Capacity
modules.description: Launch Templates, ASG configuration, scaling policies, health checks, lifecycle hooks, warm pools.
modules.productionStory: Right-size automatically. Scale out during traffic spikes, scale in to save costs.

modules.title: Amazon EFS — Elastic File System
modules.description: Serverless elastic file storage for EC2, ECS, and Lambda shared across AZs.
modules.productionStory: Shared POSIX file system accessible concurrently from thousands of instances.

modules.title: AWS X-Ray — Distributed Tracing & Observability
modules.description: Trace requests across microservices, analyze latency bottlenecks, and debug errors.
modules.productionStory: Visualize microservice call graphs and pinpoint latency spikes in real time.

modules.title: AWS CodeDeploy — Deployment Automation
modules.description: Automate code deployments to EC2, ECS, and AWS Lambda with zero downtime.
modules.productionStory: Safe zero-downtime deployments with automatic rollbacks on alarm triggers.

modules.title: Amazon GuardDuty — Intelligent Threat Detection
modules.description: Continuous security monitoring using ML to detect compromised accounts and resources.
modules.productionStory: AI-driven threat detection analyzing CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs.

modules.title: Amazon Inspector — Automated Vulnerability Assessment
modules.description: Automated vulnerability scanning for EC2 instances, ECR container images, and Lambda functions.
modules.productionStory: Continually scan container images and OS packages for CVE vulnerabilities.

modules.title: AWS Security Hub — Centralized Security Posture
modules.description: Centralized security state management and automated compliance checks across accounts.
modules.productionStory: Single pane of glass for multi-account security compliance standards.

modules.title: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) — Resource Sharing
modules.description: Share AWS resources across AWS accounts or within your AWS Organization securely.
modules.productionStory: Share Subnets, Transit Gateways, and Route53 rules without duplicate deployment.

modules.title: AWS Cost Explorer & Budgets — Cost Optimization
modules.description: Analyze AWS spending, set budget alerts, and enforce cost allocation tags.
modules.productionStory: Prevent cloud bill surprises with anomaly detection and automated budget actions.
